BOSUN_AWAKE_UNTIL.meaning: Until when the Mac is kept awake (HH:MM; at or before the start time means past midnight)

BOSUN_DAYS.meaning: The days bosun starts on, in pmset's letters: MTWRFSU, Monday first

BOSUN_START_AT_LOGIN.meaning: Start bosun when you log in, during your hours (1), or only at the start time and from Start (0)

BOSUN_START_TIME.meaning: When bosun starts on those days (HH:MM); the Mac is woken just after it

BOSUN_UPDATE_CHANNEL.meaning: What bosun update follows: the dated releases, or the head of main
